title: Deliberate forward-secrecy limitation
summary: queue.transport/2 in dev5 is PSK-based and does not provide forward secrecy. If the long-term PSK is later compromised, recorded sessions may be decryptable when their public handshake transcript/nonces were captured.
invariants: Do not claim forward secrecy for dev5.
The existing project X25519 surface is intentionally not used because its documented semantics are not the standard clamped X25519 protocol.
A future standards-qualified ephemeral key agreement or TLS 1.3 transport may add forward secrecy without moving queue delivery semantics into the transport.
Any future forward-secrecy upgrade must preserve fail-closed peer admission and receiver semantics.

provenance.claim: Documentation states provided properties, PSK compromise consequence, non-use of experimental X25519 and future TLS/ephemeral option.
Validation explicitly states that dev5 does not provide forward secrecy.
